rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an unsolved or puzzling mystery, especially an unexplained situation or thing rather than a mere secret.

example.english: This matter is still a mystery to this day.
example.traditional: 呢件事到而家仲係個謎團。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 go3 mai4 tyun4

rows.note: Use this when a mystery is a secret or concealed information, not for something that is simply baffling.

example.english: This mystery is our secret, so don't tell anyone.
example.traditional: 呢個係我哋之間嘅秘密，唔好同人講。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 bei3 mat6 m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2

rows.note: Use this as the genre label for a mystery or detective story when the medium is clear from context.

example.english: This film is a mystery, and you can't guess the ending.
example.traditional: 呢套電影係推理片，結局估你唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hai6 teoi1 lei5 pin2 git3 guk6 gu2 nei5 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when the mystery is a person presented as an obscure or puzzling figure.

example.english: The person who always wears a mask is a real mystery.
example.traditional: 嗰個成日戴住口罩嘅人，真係神秘人物。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 seng4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 hau2 zaau3 ge3 jan4 zan1 hai6 san4 bei3 jan4 mat6
